name: Reactive Mail
text:
Often heavily battle scared from use, this chain mail is commonly issued to frontline soldiers who are tasked with battling through enemies to reach high-value targets across the battlefield.

Activate–Quick Spike r (manipulate, metal)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature within 15 feet uses a manipulate action

---
Effect An iron spike launches from your armor at the target, dealing 2d8 piercing damage to the target (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). If the target critically fails, the triggering action is disrupted.
